founder.label: From the Founder
founder.title: Hi, I'm Benson 👋
founder.paragraph1: I built Sweetee to help me and my girlfriend Ya connect more meaningfully in a long distance relationship. I've found that it's easy to get stuck exchanging updates instead of actually sharing things together.
founder.paragraph2: I want to create a space for play and real conversation, a break from the daily routine. After all, it's these small moments that compound into a stronger bond over time.
founder.paragraph3: I hope you and your person find something special in here too. :)
